title: Compatibility of vertex labels
statement: Let $q,k,n\in\mathbb{N}$, choose a perfect matching in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices per part, and assign a label in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ to each matching edge. Give each vertex the label of its matching edge. Whenever two vertices are joined by an edge of the chosen matching, their labels are equal.
hypotheses_covered: natural numbers q, k, and n
a perfect matching in the complete q-partite graph
an assignment of labels in {0,...,n-1} to the matching edges
